scripts.pinned_comment:
[EPISODE_URL]

The full episode runs this on an illustrative inn: 20 rooms, $180 average daily rate, 70 percent occupancy, and the booking-site share Cloudbeds reports worldwide. It shows why the recoverable amount, not the commission total, sets what the inn can pay, and what is left after the work.
description: Total booking-site commissions is the easy number to reach for. It is the wrong one, because a small inn is never going to move all of it. It needs the sites.
The number that matters is what a recovery service can actually shift, and that is what caps what the inn can pay for the job.
Nobody selling this work has published that figure. EP009 calculates it on an illustrative 20-room inn.
